title: Excavations in Palestine and Trans-Jordan, 1939-40: Jerusalem. The Third Wall
author: (round-up; Hebrew University and ASOR, C. S. Fisher)
location_note: Behind the American School of Oriental Research and near the Hijazi Mosque, Jerusalem; placed by name.
notes: Aug. 1940: stretch of the 'Third Wall' (23 m) with a tower, and a second large tower near the Hijazi Mosque. Modern 'houses, cisterns, &c.' built on the wall line are named only as obstacles (not recorded features). No eligible feature.
